text:
erin: follow-up from the autoscale + dedicated-pool cutover chat. main ask: design an incremental cutover that guarantees no double-crediting, clear rollback, and bounded latency impact. putting proposal here for quick feedback.

mohit: love incremental. can you list the smallest safe steps?

erin: stepped plan: (A) ship read-only ledger telemetry + health checks, (B) start consulting ledger on admit reads but keep writes local, (C) bulk-checkpoint snapshots from pools into ledger and mark migrated, (D) flip writes to ledger and disable local mutation. each step reversible.

claire: how do we prevent double-crediting during C? checkpoints must be atomic and idempotent. suggest bulk_checkpoint(pool_id, snapshot, epoch) that returns applied=true/false. if false, operator retries.

diego: what about admission latency in B? extra RPC for reads could add jitter. propose local short-term cache (ttl=80ms) + optimistic local fastpath for SLA-exempt tenants. SLA-tenants should block for accurate ledger consult.

yasmin: need clear runbook toggles: feature flags in helm: admit.use_ledger_reads, admit.use_ledger_writes, admit.fallback_policy. ops runbook pages: `dedicated/cutover-ledger` with exact kubectl/helm steps.

erin: TTL + idempotency: every claim has request_id and expires after claim_ttl (default 30s). reconciler sweeps expired claims and emits ledger.reclaimed. attach claim_origin pod metadata for audits.

mohit: reconciler must be rate-limited to avoid thundering on restarts. also expose metric `reconciler.backoff` and `reconciler.reclaimed_count`.

claire: checkpoint conflict handling: conflict_count metric + checkpoint_duration_ms. if conflicts > threshold, abort cutover and revert to read-only phase.

diego: autoscaler hysteresis: use moving-window queue signal for scale up (45s) and longer cooldown for scale down (3m). before node removal set soft_drain flag which turns off optimistic admits and forces ledger-backed routing for outstanding inflight.

yasmin: operator changes: add CRD fields: ledgerMode: [off,reads-only,writes], softDrainSeconds, optimisticPct, claimTTL. default ledgerMode=off. add CI gate to prevent enabling writes without checkpointed=true annotation on pools.

erin: perf tests: synthetic harness with 10k tenants, spike profiles, measure p50/p95/p99 before/after enabling reads. validate that cache TTL keeps p50 stable and fastpath keeps p99 under SLA.

mohit: what about bulk_checkpoint at scale? need bulk endpoint and backpressure. ledger bulk API should accept pool batches and reply with per-pool status; operator will retry failed pools with exponential backoff.

claire: security/audit: every ledger write must include signer pod identity and request_id. store audit_log entries and surface `ledger.audit_write_errors`.

diego: rollback knobs: set admit.use_ledger_reads=false and set admit.fallback_policy=force-local. also operator script to mark any pool as migrated=false to revert checkpoint semantics.

yasmin: I'll own helm/CRD work and runbook. mohits: runtime patch for idempotency + cache. claire: reconciler + checkpoint implementation. diego: perf harness and scale tests. erin: RFC follow-up doc and cutover checklist. infra-bot: schedule staging canary for ledger-exporter v1.0.0 on 2024-12-02T04:00Z.

erin: thanks – I'll write the short RFC addendum and link to canary checklist. please drop any missing edge cases here. :raised_hands:
